Her section'a mode yaz: kamera acisi degisiyorsa t2v (kesme), ayni plan suruyorsa continue. Mekan degisince yeni take + yeni chapter. Alanlari INGILIZCE ve DETAYLI yaz, diyalog istenen dilde. input_sources.where_the_brief_comes_from: The human gives the brief either in _user (scenes, about) or in the chat message that came with this file, often in Turkish. Use both. If they differ, the chat message wins.
input_sources.scenario_given: If the human describes a scenario or specific events, follow those events in that order and keep their names, places and lines. Only invent what they left open. Do not replace their plot with a different one.
input_sources.topic_only: If the human gives only a topic, invent the whole story from it.
input_sources.scene_count: Use the scene count the human gives (chat or _user.scenes). If the scenario does not fit, keep the count and compress or expand the events.
input_sources.dialogue_language: Dialogue stays in the language the human writes or asks for; set dialogue_lang to its code (tr, en, ...). Every other field is English.
input_sources.no_questions: Do not ask questions back. Deliver the finished JSON in one answer.

language.why: MiniMax H3 video prompts must be English. Turkish/other languages in visual fields hurt quality.
write_in_english: setup.look, camera, palette, lighting, era, style
characters[].notes, voice, trigger (names may stay as proper nouns)
takes[].title (optional scene name), takes[].sections: title, location, character, action, camera, opening_frame, ending_frame, visual_style, audio, music, important, logline
language.dialogue_exception: dialogue may stay in the spoken story language (set dialogue_lang: tr|en|ar|…). Everything else = English.

_instructions.what_this_is: Text-only Continuum package for MiniMax H3 Studio. Human writes scene count + topic only. You write the film. Each take = 8 sections (8x5s = 40s) in one location, built from cuts (t2v) and unbroken pieces (continue) per shot_structure; each unbroken piece renders as a Continuum chain that carries motion and references. Story continues take-to-take. Studio composes official H3: integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music. No images, portraits, or URLs.

defaults.total_runtime: scenes x 40s at 5s/beat, then concat. 5 takes = 200s.
defaults.quality_note: Leave quality/steps as-is unless the user asks. Studio Produce uses the user's Draft/Final preset when they click Üret.
defaults.take_count: EQUALS _user.scenes. Clone/delete placeholder takes until takes.length == scenes.

studio_mode.do_not_use: h3-cinema/v1 is the 12×5s Character / location (face-lock) package. This file is the Continuum package for long uninterrupted takes.

how_pipeline_works: 1) Read input_sources: brief from _user and/or the chat message. Invent only what is missing. Visual fields ENGLISH.
2) Write takes.length = scenes, each with EXACTLY 8 detailed sections. Follow shot_structure for mode on every section. One continuing film.
3) User imports. Studio opens Kesintisiz and composes the official 3-block H3 prompt per beat. Nothing generates yet.
4) User clicks Uret. Each t2v section starts a fresh shot with face lock; the continue sections after it render as one Continuum chain until the next t2v or chapter change. Then concat.
5) No portraits, stills, urls, base64. No integrated_multimodal_description key in the JSON.

field_guide.mode: t2v | continue on EVERY section. t2v = cut to a new camera setup; continue = the same shot rolls on. See shot_structure.
field_guide.title: Short English beat title.
field_guide.location: Place name matching locations[].name. A take stays in one location; a new location starts a new take and chapter with a t2v section.
field_guide.character: Who is on screen — exact characters[].name, plus visible creatures[].name / vehicles[].name (comma-separate, at most 8 names).
field_guide.action: ENGLISH. THIS section only. 2-5 present-tense visible sentences: body, hands, eyes, props, weather, light. On continue, pick up exactly where the previous section ended and do not re-describe the place or the character.
field_guide.dialogue: Spoken lines THIS beat only. Empty if silent. May stay in the story language; set dialogue_lang. Studio wraps as says: <d>[Lang] ...</d>.
field_guide.camera: ENGLISH. On t2v: shot size + height + lens feel + move. On continue: how the SAME shot keeps moving; no new angle. Angles vary only across t2v cuts.
field_guide.visual_style: Usually empty (inherit setup) or Live-action, cinematic.
field_guide.audio: ENGLISH. Diegetic only: room tone, Foley, weather, breath. This becomes overall_soundscape. No BGM.
field_guide.music: N/A unless the user asked for score. This becomes non_diegetic_music.
field_guide.important: Must-lock continuity (wardrobe, prop in hand). Short.
field_guide.opening_frame: Visible composition at the start. On continue it equals the previous ending_frame.
field_guide.ending_frame: Visible composition at the end; the next continue section starts from it.

cast_guide.characters: Invent unique names from about. notes = ENGLISH appearance, age, wardrobe (identity lock). voice optional English. trigger = same as name. lora_id empty. No images.
cast_guide.locations: name + ENGLISH architecture, time of day, weather. Text only.
cast_guide.creatures: Usually empty. If needed: name + ENGLISH anatomy. No images.
cast_guide.vehicles: Usually empty. If needed: name + ENGLISH shape, size, materials. Name them in section character. No images.

setup_guide.look_camera_palette_lighting_era: Global film bible IN ENGLISH; use auto if unsure. Same look for the whole film. Location/time may change at a take boundary, not mid-take.

rules: The brief comes from _user and/or the chat message (see input_sources). Do not ask the human more questions.
Write ALL visual fields in English. Dialogue may stay in the spoken language.
Keep schema h3-cinema-seamless/v1, studio_mode seamless, seamless true, duration 5 unless asked.
takes.length = _user.scenes. Each take EXACTLY 8 filled sections. ONE continuing film.
Fill author fields in DETAIL (action 2-5 sentences, specific camera, diegetic audio). Studio composes the official 3-block H3 prompt.
Do NOT write integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music keys.

take_guide.scene_count: takes.length MUST equal _user.scenes. Clone the last take{} if the file has fewer placeholders.
take_guide.shots_per_scene: EXACTLY 8 filled sections per take. action not empty.
take_guide.one_continuing_film: ONE story from the brief. Take 2 continues Take 1. Not separate shorts.
take_guide.inside_a_take: Same location, wardrobe and time of day. Mix cuts and continuous pieces per shot_structure: a take is usually 2-4 unbroken pieces, each a t2v followed by 1-3 continue sections.
take_guide.between_takes: Hard cut OK. New location/time OK at the boundary. Plot and names continue.
take_guide.chapters: Set takes[].chapter (e.g. Part 1 - Bedroom). Every section of that take joins the chapter; a chain never crosses a chapter boundary. New location = new take + new chapter.

human_writes_only.scenes: Integer. 5 = 5 takes. Each take = EXACTLY 8 sections. 5 sahneli = 5 take x 8 shot.
human_writes_only.about: Topic or full scenario, in _user.about or in the chat message. Turkish OK; YOU write the visual fields in English. Dialogue stays in the story language.

h3_prompt_format.do_not_write_the_three_blocks: Studio composes the official H3 prompt from author fields. Do NOT output integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music yourself. Do NOT paste those keys into action.
studio_composes_exactly: integrated_multimodal_description: SCENE – {title}. [Shot 1] {visual_style} Location: {location} Main character: {character} Action: {action} Camera: {camera} {character} (S1) says: <d>[{Lang}] {dialogue}</d> Constraints: {important}
h3_prompt_format.quality: Author fields must be DETAILED so the composed prompt is rich. Short generic beats (he walks, she looks) are rejected. Each action = 2-5 present-tense visible sentences for THIS beat only: body, hands, eyes, weather, props, light. Camera = size + lens feel + move + height (not just close-up). audio = diegetic room/Foley only. music = N/A unless the user asked for score.

shot_structure.principle: mode t2v = a CUT: a new camera setup (new angle or framing, new location, or a time jump). mode continue = the SAME shot still rolling: the camera may keep moving (push-in, follow, orbit, crane) but never jumps to a new framing or angle.
shot_structure.rhythm: Build the film from short unbroken pieces: one t2v section followed by 1-3 continue sections (10-20 s without a cut), then cut with the next t2v. Camera variety comes from the cuts, never from continue sections. A single t2v section without continues is fine for a quick insert.
shot_structure.location_change: A new location or time jump is ALWAYS t2v and starts a new chapter.
continue_rules: opening_frame = the previous section's ending_frame (same framing, same positions).
camera describes how the SAME shot keeps going (e.g. 'the slow push-in continues over his shoulder until the monitor fills the frame'); no new shot size, angle or lens.
action covers only the next seconds; do not re-describe the location, the wardrobe or who the character is.
location stays the same as the previous section.
shot_structure.one_shot_per_section: Each section is ONE shot. Never write 'cut to', 'cut-in', 'montage', 'multi-angle' or 'then a close-up of ...' inside a section; make it a new t2v section instead. One section (5 s) holds one or two visible actions.
shot_structure.mode_required: Write mode (t2v or continue) on EVERY section; Studio does not guess it.

example.camera: Wide shot from behind his left shoulder, slow push-in toward the monitor.
example.ending_frame: Over-the-shoulder medium shot, monitor glowing ahead of him.

example.camera: The push-in continues over his shoulder until his hands and the boss health bar fill the frame.
example.opening_frame: Over-the-shoulder medium shot, monitor glowing ahead of him.

example.camera: Cut to a side medium shot at desk height, static, as the screen freezes.
example.ending_frame: Side medium shot, his hands lifted off the keyboard.

final_checklist: Every section has mode t2v or continue. A camera angle change, new location or time jump is t2v.

Every continue section: same location as the previous section, opening_frame equals the previous ending_frame, camera describes the same shot still moving, action does not re-describe the place or character.
No section contains 'cut to', 'cut-in', 'montage' or several shots.
Every section has opening_frame and ending_frame filled.
takes.length equals the scene count, each take has exactly 8 sections, one location per take, and takes[].chapter is set.
character and location use exact card names, spelled the same everywhere.
The story follows the human's scenario and scene count.
All visual fields are English; dialogue_lang matches the dialogue.
_instructions and _user are deleted; the answer is only valid JSON.

_user.READ_ME_HUMAN: Fill scenes + about here, or just write the scene count, topic and scenario in your chat message. Then send this WHOLE file to an AI.
_user.READ_ME_AI: The brief is in _user and/or the chat message (see _instructions.input_sources). Follow the human's scenario; invent only what is missing. Follow shot_structure exactly. Do not ask questions. Do not leave action/camera/audio/opening_frame/ending_frame empty.
